ValidationRule.description: This validation rule throws error if Customer Account is not populated while creating Sales Order or modifying Customer Account field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(CustomerAccount__c) ), ISBLANK(CustomerAccount__c), ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, "Modon - Egypt") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer Account is required. Please select a Customer Account before saving the Sales Order.
